content.title: The 2026 Oscars winners list: 'One Battle After Another,' Sinners,' all the night’s wins!
content.text: It’s been a long awards season, but we’re finally here at the finish line: the 2026 Oscars!This image released by Warner Bros. Pictures shows Leonardo DiCaprio in a scene from "One Battle After Another." (Warner Bros. Pictures via AP)“Sinners” broke records with its 16 nominations, but it couldn't quite beat "One Battle After Another, which took home six of its 13 nominations, including Best Picture, Best Director, Best Editing, Best Adapted Screenplay, Best Supporting Actor, and Best Casting. "Sinners" did take home four of it's 16 nominations, including Best Original Screenplay, Best Score, Best Cinematography, and Best Actor.We got the first ever award for Best Casting, which went to "One Battle After Another."And we had one of the biggest surprises of the night in the Best Live Action Short with a tie between the films "The Singers" and "Two People Exchanging Saliva." There have only been six ties in Oscar history, the most famous being between Barbra Streisand and Katherine Hepburn in 1969 for Best Actress.
